caption: A concert speaker stack blasts a bass note, and the fabric grille on its front visibly pulses in and out.

sa.check: A stack of concert speakers with a fabric grille on the front.
The grille pulses in and out.
The pulses are repeated, in beats.
The speakers are a stack of several cabinets, not one.
The grille is cloth, not a metal mesh.

pc.expect: The grille moves in and out relative to the cabinet, ballooning and flattening, while the cabinet stays put.
pc.fail: The whole cabinet moves in and out with the grille; or the grille slides up or sideways across the front; or the grille peels off and floats; or it flaps only at one corner like a loose flag.

pc.expect: Between pulses and after the last one the grille lies flat over its frame.
pc.fail: The grille freezes bulged outward or sucked inward and stays so; or it is flat in one frame and bulged in the next and never flattens; or it comes to rest hanging loose off its frame.

pc.expect: The fabric stretches and flexes as cloth; the cabinet is rigid.
pc.fail: The cabinet's wooden sides bulge; or the grille shatters or cracks; or the grille stretches longer and stays longer.

pc.expect: A loose cable, banner or cloth near the stack stirs with the pulses.
pc.fail: The cloth hangs dead still while the grille pulses hard; or it flaps while the grille is still; or it streams steadily as in a wind while the grille pulses in beats.
pc.precondition: A loose cable, banner or cloth hangs near the stack.

pc.expect: The cabinets keep their count and shape; the grille does not pass into the cabinet.
pc.fail: A cabinet appears or vanishes; or cabinets merge; or the grille passes into the cabinet; or the stack changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The grille's colour, the logos and the stage backdrop stay the same.
pc.fail: The grille changes colour; or a logo moves; or the stage backdrop changes.
